name: Gemini Client
description: Single-player utility / sandbox client for Minecraft 26.3: 280 modules, a window or panel ClickGUI, a draggable HUD and a pathfinding bot powered by a bundled Baritone. Server connections are blocked while it is installed.

custom.gemini:baritone: Drives the bundled Baritone through baritone.api.BaritoneAPI (all # commands pass through) and falls back to a built-in 3D A* engine (#goto, #mine, #follow, #tunnel, #farm, #explore, #excavate, #sel, #thisway, #axis).
